Method of Attack: Critical account password reset flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to arbitrarily reset administrator passwords and take control of websites
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Essential Addons for Elementor plugin versions 5.4.0 to 5.7.1
Attack Vector: Exploitation of a vulnerability via probing for plugin version through 'readme.txt' file and use of proof-of-concept exploit published on GitHub
